review.en: An album of five songs made by Fairuz with her son Ziad Rahbani, who brought jazz harmony, lighter colloquial writing and a smaller, looser band to a voice long tied to the grand Rahbani brothers style. It marked a turn in her work that Ziad would continue for decades. The record was reissued internationally in 2019, a sign of how it has kept its place.
review.zh: 菲鲁兹与儿子齐亚德·拉赫巴尼合作的五首歌。齐亚德带来了爵士和声、更轻快的口语化写法和更小更松的乐队，而她的嗓音此前长期与拉赫巴尼兄弟的宏大风格连在一起。这张唱片标志着她作品的一次转向，齐亚德此后把这条路走了几十年。2019 年它在海外再版，可见它一直没有退场。
